<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 240">
  <title>Right‑angled triangle and Pythagoras theorem</title>

  <!-- Triangle -->
  <polygon points="150,180 150,80 300,180" fill="none" stroke="#003366" stroke-width="3">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </polygon>

  <!-- Right‑angle marker -->
  <rect x="145" y="175" width="10" height="10" fill="#003366"/>

  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="140" y="130" font-size="14" fill="#003366">a</text>
  <text x="225" y="190" font-size="14" fill="#003366">b</text>
  <text x="210" y="120" font-size="14" fill="#003366">c</text>
  <text x="200" y="50" font-size="14" fill="#003366">a² + b² = c²</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 240">
  <title>Circle geometry diagram</title>
  <!-- light background -->
  <rect x="12" y="12" width="576" height="216" fill="#f9f9f9" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- outer circle (circumference) -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="120" r="80" fill="none" stroke="#0033aa" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- centre point -->
  <circle cx="300" cy="120" r="4" fill="#000000" stroke="none"/>
  <!-- radius line with animation -->
  <line x1="300" y1="120" x2="380" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </line>
  <!-- diameter line -->
  <line x1="220" y1="120" x2="380" y2="120" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- labels -->
  <text x="295" y="115" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Centre</text>
  <text x="385" y="115" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Radius</text>
  <text x="250" y="135" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Diameter</text>
  <text x="300" y="210" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Circumference</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 240">
  <title>Series circuit loop</title>
  <!-- Loop wires -->
  <line x1="80" y1="60" x2="180" y2="60" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="230" y1="60" x2="320" y2="60" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="370" y1="60" x2="460" y2="60" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="460" y1="60" x2="460" y2="180" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="460" y1="180" x2="80" y2="180" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="180" x2="80" y2="120" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="80" y1="100" x2="80" y2="60" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Cell plates -->
  <line x1="60" y1="100" x2="100" y2="100" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <line x1="70" y1="120" x2="90" y2="120" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Resistors -->
  <rect x="180" y="55" width="50" height="10" fill="lightgreen" stroke="black" stroke-width="2">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <rect x="320" y="55" width="50" height="10" fill="lightgreen" stroke="black" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="250" y="40" font-size="14" fill="black">Same current</text>
  <text x="250" y="210" font-size="14" fill="black">Voltage shared</text>
  <text x="130" y="110" font-size="14" fill="black">Cell</text>
</svg>
reviewEdits: Extended the lower wire to close the only loop.

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 240">
  <title>Photosynthesis Diagram (GCSE)</title>

  <!-- Chlorophyll leaf -->
  <rect x="260" y="80" width="80" height="80" fill="#2E8B57" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2">
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </rect>
  <text x="260" y="75" font-size="14" fill="#000">Chlorophyll</text>

  <!-- Sunlight arrow (down) -->
  <line x1="300" y1="20" x2="300" y2="80" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="295,80 305,80 300,85" fill="#000" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="310" y="50" font-size="14" fill="#000">Sunlight</text>

  <!-- CO₂ arrow (right) -->
  <line x1="150" y1="120" x2="260" y2="120" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="260,115 260,125 265,120" fill="#000" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="200" y="110" font-size="14" fill="#000">CO₂</text>

  <!-- Water arrow (up) -->
  <line x1="300" y1="220" x2="300" y2="160" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="295,160 305,160 300,155" fill="#000" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="310" y="190" font-size="14" fill="#000">Water</text>

  <!-- Glucose arrow (right) -->
  <line x1="340" y1="105" x2="470" y2="105" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="470,100 470,110 475,105" fill="#000" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="380" y="95" font-size="14" fill="#000">Glucose</text>

  <!-- Oxygen arrow (right) -->
  <line x1="340" y1="145" x2="470" y2="145" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <polygon points="470,140 470,150 475,145" fill="#000" stroke="#000" stroke-width="2"/>
  <text x="380" y="135" font-size="14" fill="#000">Oxygen</text>
</svg>

<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 600 240">
  <title>States of Matter – Particle Diagram</title>
  <!-- Light background -->
  <rect x="12" y="12" width="576" height="216" fill="#f9f9f9" stroke="#cccccc" stroke-width="2"/>
  <!-- Labels -->
  <text x="140" y="40" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Solid</text>
  <text x="300" y="40" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Liquid</text>
  <text x="460" y="40" font-size="14" fill="#000000">Gas</text>

  <!-- Solid particles (tight cluster, tiny vibration) -->
  <circle cx="120" cy="120" r="8" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="120;122;120" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
    <animate attributeName="opacity" values="1;0.4;1" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="140" cy="120" r="8" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="140;142;140" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="130" cy="135" r="8" fill="#000000" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="135;137;135" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Liquid particles (moderate spacing, sliding past each other) -->
  <circle cx="260" cy="120" r="8" fill="#0000aa" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="260;280;260" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="300" cy="120" r="8" fill="#0000aa" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="300;280;300" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="280" cy="135" r="8" fill="#0000aa" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="135;155;135" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>

  <!-- Gas particles (widely spaced, large fast movement) -->
  <circle cx="440" cy="120" r="8" fill="#008800" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="440;500;440" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="520" cy="120" r="8" fill="#008800" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cx" values="520;460;520" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
  <circle cx="480" cy="150" r="8" fill="#008800" stroke="#000000" stroke-width="1">
    <animate attributeName="cy" values="150;190;150" dur="2s" repeatCount="indefinite"/>
  </circle>
</svg>
